hadith:
Invocations - Narrated Um Khalid bint Khalid:

I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) seeking refuge with Allah from the punishment of the grave.
message: Wealth and worldly possessions will not save us on the Day of Judgment, when Allah, Al Hakam (The Judge), will hold us accountable for our deeds. Instead, we should focus on building our spiritual foundation through righteous actions and remembrance of Allah, seeking His protection from the punishment of the grave and trusting in His perfect justice and wisdom.
name:
Al Hakam - الْحَكَمُ - The Judge

The name Al Hakam emphasizes Allah's role as the supreme judge who determines justice and fairness. It signifies His authority to rule over His creation and to decide matters, rewarding the righteous and punishing the wrongdoers. The use of this name serves to remind believers of the ultimate accountability they have in the Hereafter.
verse:
Al-Masad - The Palm Fiber - 111:2

Neither his wealth nor ˹worldly˺ gains will benefit him.
